title: Purpose and Buyer Truth
dek: Start with the buyer’s real question and define what a trustworthy answer must contain.
objective: Name the audience, decision, evidence boundary, unknowns, and one honest next action.
practice: Name the buyer and the decision in plain language.
List the evidence a reasonable buyer can inspect.
Route the next decision to an accountable human owner.
boundary: This teaches a method. It does not certify a system, prove a company is trustworthy, guarantee AI retrieval, or promise revenue, rankings, safety, interoperability, or conversion.
